memory_candidates.content: In a Lean development where a downstream theorem instantiates a universe-polymorphic validity predicate at a concrete Type 0 frame (e.g. Nat), pinning the statement to the concrete universe (MValid.{_, 0}) breaks every consumer that needs the polymorphic form. The additive fix is a universe-invariance bridge landed BEFORE the pin: the descend direction (Type v to Type 0) is a ULift transport plus an induction showing forcing commutes with ULift.down; the ascend direction is free via soundness composed with completeness at the concrete universe. Both bridge lemmas type-check against the UNPINNED signature, so they land green on their own and the pin plus its consumer updates then form one atomic batch. Planning this as two phases instead of one is what keeps every phase boundary green -- pinning and consumer-updating cannot be separated, but the bridge can be separated from both.
